definitions.short: properly, a distinguished thing ; hence something valuable , as a product or fruit
definitions.full: H4022. meged מֶ֫גֶד noun masculine excellence (Late Hebrew id., choice fruit ; Syriac fruit ; Arabic glory, honour, nobility ); — ׳מ construct Deut 33:13 4 t. Deuteronomy 33; plural מְגָדִים Cant 4:13; Song 7:14; suffix מְגָדָיו Cant 4:16 — excellence: excellent or choice things; always of gifts of nature: ׳מ שָׁמַיִם 33:13 i.e. (natural) gifts of heaven; ׳מ שֶׁמֶשׁ תְּבוּאֹת 33:14 ; ׳מ יְרָחִים גֶּרֶשׁ 33:14 ; ׳מ עוֺלָם גִּבְעוֺת 33:15 (|| קֶדֶם הַרֲרֵי ראֹשׁ ); ׳מ וּמְלֹאָהּ אֶרֶץ ; plural abstract מ ׳מְּרִי (= excellent fruit) Song 4:13 , 16 ; ׳מ alone = foregoing, Songs 7:14.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent;
